last.verdict: Teva's three growth drugs surged 33% and guidance rose again, more than offsetting falling sales of generic cancer drug lenalidomide.

takeaways.label: Growth drugs accelerate
takeaways.text: Austedo ($751M, +21%), Ajovy ($269M, +61%) and Uzedy ($85M, +96%) together grew 33% to about $1.1 billion, driving the quarter.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised again
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue outlook rose to $16.7–17.0 billion from $16.5–16.85 billion. Austedo's forecast moved to $2.55–2.65 billion from $2.45–2.60 billion.

takeaways.label: Margins improved
takeaways.text: Adjusted gross margin rose to 58.7% from 55.3%, and adjusted operating margin to 31.7% from 28.9%, even as total revenue fell 2% to $4.4 billion.

takeaways.label: Profit outlook barely moves
takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS guidance is $1.92–2.11, versus $1.91–2.11 before. Top of the operating income range was cut to $3.9 billion, with $0.71 per share of acquired research charges included.

history.verdict: Stronger brand-drug sales and raised guidance outweighed a profit miss.

reasons.label: Austedo outlook raised
reasons.text: 2026 Austedo sales guidance lifted to $2.45–2.6 billion; U.S. sales up 33%.

reasons.label: Revenue guidance raised
reasons.text: 2026 revenue outlook raised to $16.5–16.85 billion on Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy.

reasons.label: Miss blamed on deal
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of 2 cents missed; Emalex acquisition cost about 61 cents per share.
